response.original_title: {Step by Step Guide}How to Add Someone to a Disney Cruise Reservation
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Disney Cruise reservation, you must call 1-866-254-7549 USA/Canada Disney Cruise Line directly or contact your travel agent, as passenger additions cannot be completed through the website or mobile app Requirements for Adding a GuestStateroom Capacity: Your current cabin must have enough maximum occupancy to fit the additional guest (such as an upper Pullman bed or sofa bed) Contact OptionsUS & Canada: Call Disney Cruise Line at 1-866-254-7549 USA/Canada or the general support line at 1-866-254-7549 USA/Canada.UK: Call +44-120-420-8151
